payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations, indicating which types the model works best and worst for.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting implicit discourse relations with a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows improved performance on explicit discourse relations, achieving a macro F1-score comparable to previous best results (over 90%).
The model performs particularly well on the contingency relation, with a performance improvement of 1.42%.
The model struggles with binary classification, as indicated by the CRF layer's unsuitability for this task.
